fields.label: About
fields.options: Links one record to its folder in SharePoint. With an Automatic mapping these are created for you on a record's first attachment; with On demand, a record gets one only when someone asks: here, or with Create folder now on the record's Files in Microsoft 365 panel. To add one here, pick the record, then either leave Existing Folder empty to create the folder the mapping describes, or paste the address or path of a folder that already exists to link it. Once saved, the record's attachments that are still on this server move into the folder. The link uses the folder's Microsoft item id, so it survives renaming or moving the folder inside the library. Deleting this record only forgets the link: the SharePoint folder and its files stay.
